name: bullish_butterfly_confirmed_next_open
ties: strict extrema; reject tied extremes and simultaneous high/low center
same_kind: replace latest pivot only with a later more extreme confirmed pivot; never rewrite emitted past output
context: only a newly confirmed D emits an event; feature delayed by one completed decision bar
entry: completed h1_vol_ok; current closed close>open and close>previous_close; close >= lagged D+0.10*XA
duplicate_signal: single event per confirmed five-pivot identity; no persistent/repeated event
execution: existing shared long-only spot engine, signal at current close -> next open
research_choices: finite tolerances, pivot width, C/BC/CD filters and response threshold are preregistered implementation choices, not a claimed exact ideal-pattern definition or profitability proof
